name.baseName: xxx Door, inner, glass-wood, at plant

dataSetInformation.common:generalComment:
The dataset can be applied to describe an average room door. The door frame is made of massive wood, the door leaf is made of wood with a glass insert (62 % wood, 38% glass). The lock, door handles and frame joints are fabricated from steel. Data are based on a door of 0.8x2.0 m and scaled to 1m2. 1 m2 of the wooden inner door weighs 27.6 kg. The functional life time for the door frame is 50 years, for the door leaf it is 30 years. 
Geography: Data from producers in Switzerland.
Technology: The technology represents average European production.
Version: 2.2
Energy values: Undefined
Local category: Bauteile
Local subcategory: Türen

technology.technologyDescriptionAndIncludedProcesse:
The technology represents average European production.

# Included processes
This dataset describes the production of 1m2 (visible area) inner door, including the processes for the installation. Not included are transports from plant to construction site.
